scope: Read-only bounded scout beyond the frozen PathBank shortlist. Not exhaustive and not a curation verdict.

ranked_candidates.label: sulfoquinovose degradation I
ranked_candidates.boundary: Four reactions from free SQ to DHAP and DHPS. Glycoside hydrolysis, transport and DHPS mineralization are distinct context, not silently included.
ranked_candidates.access: 2014 original institutional PDF and 2021 full original XML retrieved. Primary abstracts and 2021 introduction/discussion inspected in this screen.
ranked_candidates.priority_reason: Direct purified-enzyme evidence for the full native boundary, current detailed biochemical/structural follow-up, all four exact native members verified.
limits: 2021 beta-anomer preference and sulforhamnose side product require exact current chemical identity checks.
Do not conflate GO:0061722 definition mentioning pyruvate with native DHAP + DHPS endpoint. GO:1902777 is broader catabolism.
Native/current cofactor, reversibility and assembly claims still require full curation.
ranked_candidates.decision: Root assigned complete curation; no YAML created during scout.

ranked_candidates.label: methylthiopropanoate degradation I (cleavage)
ranked_candidates.boundary: Three independently named native reactions: MMPA CoA activation, oxidation to methylthioacryloyl-CoA, hydrolytic cleavage to methanethiol, acetaldehyde and CO2. DMSP demethylation is outside this exact pathway.
ranked_candidates.access: Original 2011 paper PDF retrieved from institutional hosting; original paper first-page experiments inspected via web PDF extraction; all three native reaction XML bodies retrieved.
ranked_candidates.priority_reason: Complete distinct marine carbon/sulfur route experimentally reconstituted with named DmdB/C/D proteins.
limits: Native summary incorrectly calls oxidative dehydrogenation a reduction; use actual reaction/primary source.
Generic electron acceptor must not silently become a proven physiological ETF partner.
Full primary PDF and updated chemistry need author-level review before curation.
ranked_candidates.decision: Strong next candidate, not the broad DMSP superpathway. PWY-6052 is one reaction and unsuitable as standalone under skill.

ranked_candidates.label: ergothioneine biosynthesis I (bacteria)
ranked_candidates.species: Mycolicibacterium smegmatis; avoid transferring H37Rv measurements without evidence
ranked_candidates.boundary: Seven native reaction objects including five EgtA/D/B/C/E enzyme functions, a terminal reduction and thiol/thione tautomerization; every object needs reconciliation, not a five-box shortcut.
ranked_candidates.access: 2010 primary abstract retrieved (full article subscription access unresolved); 2015 original full XML retrieved and abstract inspected; all seven native members verified plus three terminal reaction objects.
ranked_candidates.priority_reason: Entire distinct bacterial thiol synthesis route, independent of maintained glutathione/mycothiol pathways.
limits: 2010 paper did not resolve EgtE; 2015 direct EgtE paper addresses sulfenic intermediate and reductant dependence.
Do not double-count terminal overall equation versus component chemistry, or collapse thiol/thione identities.
GO:0052699 includes fungal routes; MetaCyc bacterial identity is narrower.
ranked_candidates.decision: Strong larger candidate after exact terminal redox/tautomer reconciliation.

ranked_candidates.label: sulfoquinovose degradation II
ranked_candidates.boundary: Five native sulfo-Entner-Doudoroff reactions from SQ via sulfoquinovonolactone/sulfoquinovonate to pyruvate and sulfolactate.
ranked_candidates.access: Native full XML retrieved; published original primary PMC text available to web search, fresh EuropePMC full XML attempt returned500.
ranked_candidates.priority_reason: Complete mechanistically distinct route and strain beyond E. coli.
limits: Species/strain identity and SQ1 protein accessions need exact resolution.
Do not substitute KT2440 iModulon dataset or enzyme identities.
Full primary source acquisition should be retried by a different official endpoint.
ranked_candidates.decision: Additional candidate; prioritize diversity with rank2/3 before another SQ variant.

other_dispositions.label: bacillithiol biosynthesis
other_dispositions.decision: Lower readiness: original native definition and2010 primary identify BshC by genetics; no newly inspected direct terminal ligation chemistry. Do not infer ATP/product stoichiometry from enzyme name.
Broad DMSP superpathway combines competing cleavage/demethylation routes; not selected as a linear chain.

prior_mentions: No current maintained record or focused research mention for exact screened labels/IDs/reactions/papers. Original ignored source inventory has generic ergothioneine subsystem name only; retained discovery source, not a prior curated pathway or rejection.
limits: Independent candidate selection only; no atom/charge or source-to-graph completeness replay yet.
Native source mirror is an older MetaCyc snapshot; current annotations and later primary work must be reconciled.
